planets.name: HAT-P-14 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Franz with a 4.63-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-14 b was found in 2010 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Franz. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2010, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.62766098, pl_radj 1.42, pl_bmassj 3.44

quotes.title: HAT-P-14b
quotes.card: HAT-P-14b, officially named Sissi and also known as WASP-27b, is an extrasolar planet located approximately 224.2 ± 0.6 parsecs (731.2 ± 2.0 ly) away in the constellation of Hercules, orbiting the 10th magnitude F-type main-sequence star HAT-P-14.
quotes.introduction: This planet was discovered in 2010 by the HATNet Project using the transit method.
